title: Understand your Grafana Cloud bill and get alerted before it grows

blocks.content: If you're wondering what your bill is and why, this will help. In this guide you'll look at where your spend comes from, and then set (or adjust) a usage alert so you hear about it before it grows. First, let's open the Usage page.
Open the **Usage** page in Cost Management and Billing.
blocks.tooltip: This page shows what you're being charged for this billing period.

blocks.content: You're on the Usage page, where your spend for the current period lives. Next, take a look at the numbers behind your bill.

blocks.title: See where your spend comes from

blocks.content: Start with **Total spend this period**, the overall amount you've been charged so far.
blocks.tooltip: This is the headline figure that adds up everything you've used this period.

blocks.content: Now look at **Spend by product** to see which products add up to that total.
blocks.tooltip: Each row shows how much of your total comes from one product, so the biggest contributors stand out.

blocks.content: You now know your total and which products it comes from, which answers most "why is it this much?" questions. Now you'll set a Global Spend alert, so you're told when your spend approaches an amount you choose.
Select **Create your first usage alert** in the sidebar. This opens a Global Spend threshold alert form, so you don't need to navigate anywhere yourself.
blocks.tooltip: This opens the alert form with your total spend as the thing to watch.

blocks.content: Check the **Alert type** is a threshold alert, which watches your spend against a limit you set.
blocks.tooltip: This confirms the alert compares your overall spend with a limit.

blocks.content: Enter the amount you want to be warned about in **Dollar threshold**. The number is your call, so pick one you'd want a heads-up about.
blocks.tooltip: Enter the monthly spend you want to be warned about approaching.

blocks.content: Choose who should hear about it in **Contact point**.
blocks.tooltip: Pick where the notification should land, such as email or Slack.

blocks.content: Select **Create alert**. This creates a real alert that sends notifications, so it's left for you to press.
blocks.tooltip: Creating the alert starts real notifications, so this one is yours to press.

blocks.content: Once you've pressed **Create alert**, you're now all set up to be alerted: when your spend approaches the threshold you chose, you'll be notified. If you haven't pressed it yet, that's the one step left.
